releases.headline: What Dietitian-Led GLP-1 Support Looks Like
releases.snippet: GLP-1 medications are one part of a weight-management plan. Here is what registered-dietitian involvement in a GLP-1 program usually includes, and questions worth asking before enrolling.

releases.headline: How a GLP-1 Weight-Loss Consultation Works
releases.snippet: A plain walk-through of the usual stages of a telehealth GLP-1 consultation, from intake to clinical review, and why not every applicant is a candidate for medication.
